description: Answer five questions from product docs, ignoring a superseded changelog value.

contract.objective: Answer these questions using only the documents in the docs directory of the task workspace. q1: What is the request limit per minute on the Team plan? q2: What HTTP status code does the API return when a rate limit is exceeded? q3: Which generally available region launched most recently? q4: Within how many days must an invoice be paid? q5: Which plan is required for SCIM provisioning? Write answers.json as {"answers": {"q1": ..., "q5": ...}, "sources": {"q1": ..., "q5": ...}} where each source is the path of the document that supports the answer.
acceptance_criteria: Each answer is supported by the cited document
Answers reflect current, not superseded, values
